topic.title: Closing a Review Task
topic.shortdesc: How task owners can close a review task to stop reviewers from making changes while feedback is addressed or prepared for integration.

body.p: A task owner can close a review task to pause reviewer editing and reserve time to address feedback before integration. To do this, open the task and click Close review in the review task header.

Closing a task changes its status to Review closed and locks the task for reviewers. Task owners can still work in the task. The individual review statuses remain visible after the task is closed. If more review is needed, a task owner can click Reopen review to make the task editable for reviewers again and reset the review statuses for the new review cycle.
